issue_title: Freeze chosen delivery baseline and refresh retained release evidence

approach.summary: Materialize the chosen baseline into a traceable frozen state by regenerating or re-binding the retained release evidence so every referenced artifact points to the same delivery SHA and package output.
rationale: The analysis identified baseline drift as the highest-risk remaining delivery gap.

The existing release pipeline already produces `release-check-summary.md` and `.workflow/evidence/release/release-readiness-artifact.json`, so the safest path is to refresh those evidence files on the chosen baseline rather than inventing a parallel evidence chain.
This issue converts the decision from `ISS-20260418-001` into retained evidence that downstream smoke and bundle work can trust.
non_goals: Do not close the customer golden-path smoke note here.
Do not decide signed vs unsigned shipment here.
risk_controls: If the chosen baseline remains `4d63e03 / 9.0.8`, preserve the existing retained evidence and add an explicit freeze record instead of regenerating evidence unnecessarily.
If a newer SHA is selected, rerun the alignment and release-summary path on that exact SHA before treating it as a valid handoff baseline.

tasks.title: Freeze the chosen baseline into a retained delivery record
tasks.description: Create or update a retained baseline artifact that binds the selected `head_sha`, version, delivery mode placeholder, and package artifact names to the current customer-delivery session.
acceptance: There is one retained baseline record for the customer delivery session.
The retained baseline record points to the same SHA and version as the decision artifact.

tasks.title: Refresh retained release evidence on the frozen baseline
tasks.description: Run the existing alignment check, delivery gate, package validation, and release summary steps on the chosen baseline so `release-check-summary.md`, `release-readiness-artifact.json`, and related retained evidence files point to the same exact build.
acceptance: All retained release evidence files reference the chosen delivery SHA or are explicitly documented as reused from that same baseline.
`release-check-summary.md` records the same retained release decision for the chosen baseline.

dependencies: Requires the exact baseline decision from `ISS-20260418-001`.
Reuse the existing release/sign-off commands documented in `docs/release/SIGN_OFF.md`.
conflict_risks: This issue intentionally overlaps the same retained release files later referenced by shipment-mode and bundle work; executors should not hand-edit those artifacts in downstream tasks.
